about: A dial with a needle that swings to each value as it is said, over named zones and a readout: a level, a reading, a rate or a risk between a low and a high.

min.about: the low end of the dial

max.about: the high end of the dial

values.about: the values the needle goes to, in turn, split by commas

zones.about: names of equal zones from low to high, such as low|normal|high

label.about: what the dial measures, under the readout

when.about: moments the needle swings to each value; else when the value is said, or one after another
